findings.text: `unsetopt local_options nomatch` turns off two options: `local_options` and `nomatch`. Turning off `local_options` stops zsh from restoring option changes when the function returns, so the `nomatch` change leaks into the user's interactive shell. After running `nvm ls` or `nvm alias` in zsh, a later `ls *.nonexistent` stops erroring with 'no matches found'. The intended form is `setopt local_options nonomatch`. As written, the glob on the next lines still has the literal-pattern fallback, but at the cost of this global side effect.
